meta.summary: 2 new today: Open Model Hack — Gradient × Google DeepMind (open-weight-models hackathon in SF, build & evaluate open models, Lambda credits — date TBC), and From Satellite to Signal (hands-on geospatial agentic-AI workshop with AWS/Felt/Wherobots in SF — date TBC). Also resolved: the Oct 13 ComfyUI Build Night is now confirmed POSTPONED (comfy.org shows it past, Luma shows [POSTPONED]) — moved to watch. This week (Oct 13–19): TODAY Oct 13 Foundry Live agentic demo night (confirmed via iCal), Personal AI Agents/Nanda (4/5), and the Oakland Claude Code workshop series; Oct 14 Wiki3 'Own Your Own AI' at Hacker Dojo (5/5, confirmed Oct 14 & 28 via iCal), plus localhost SF, Fast Forward and The Build hackathons; Oct 16 Open Together: AI Builders Unite (5/5, Hugging Face); Oct 17 ExecuTorch on-device hackathon (5/5) + Recursive Agents (4/5); Oct 19 Universal Hackathon + Open Weight Debate Night. Oct 20 Software Projects with AI at Hacker Dojo (date now confirmed via iCal).
gaps: Several promising SF events have no date posted yet (kept with needsVerification per real URLs): Open Model Hack (luma.com/openmodelhack) and From Satellite to Signal (luma.com/m4bngiey) show agendas but no calendar date; confirm timing before relying on them.
SF Tech Week side events seen this sweep (AI Builder's Night, Cyberdefense Hackathon, CarbonBlack Builders Night, Future of Work mixer) are dated Oct 12 or earlier / past — skipped as out of window.

Recurring watch-series still have no next dated instance: Vibe Coding Nights (VCN #41 was July 2026), Vibe Night Demos (#29 full), SF Demo Night (last #16 Feb), Punk Software Hack Night (#9 last, SF Tech Week edition now past), and the 'Local AI Workshop' local-models series (latest instance past). AI Tinkerers SF still shows no upcoming SF event.

Frontier Tower lists several undated, members-only placeholder hackathons (Cline Open Source AI, Dell×NVIDIA, plus new TestMu AI, NerdConf Stranger Builds, Biohackathon Haus F26) — no dates posted, so only the two already-tracked ones are kept; the rest are on watch.

Back half of the 90-day window (mid-Nov 2026–Jan 2027) remains thin: most sources list little past late November — organizers haven't posted dates. Only SF Frontier Tech (online Zoom webinars, skipped) and Devnovate (Nov 24 HackwithBay, Dec 4 AI Demo Night, Dec 15 Agentic AI Hackathon 2.0) reach that far.
South Park Commons events in-window are firesides/talks or out-of-city (Bengaluru) — no hands-on SF build night. Noisebridge has no AI/ML events in-window.
